data.name: Waldorf Astoria Panama
data.address: 47th St. Uruguay Street, Panama City, Panamá Province, Panama
data.description:
Occupying an ultramodern tower, this high-end hotel is an 11-minute walk from the El Carmen Subway Station, 1 km from the oceanfront and 6 km from the Panamá Viejo historic district.
Posh rooms have free Wi-Fi, flat-screens, iPod docks and minibars, as well as Nespresso machines. Suites add separate living rooms, and kitchenettes or kitchens, as well as rainfall showers and/or ocean views. Room service is available 24/7
There's a luxe spa, and an outdoor pool with a hip poolside bar, plus a lobby bar and a modern restaurant. Other amenities include fitness facilities, a beauty salon and a business center.
